svg.title: Perfume Review Analyzer
svg.desc: Postcard for Perfume Review Analyzer (nlp & machine learning, Python): Finds what buyers care about in a synthetic set of Turkish perfume reviews. Turkish BERT sentiment and aspect-based analysis. Ranks the features that drive satisfaction. K-Means consumer segments with profiles. Built with Python, Transformers, PyTorch, scikit-learn, NLTK, spaCy, pandas, Seaborn.
